answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent locks a refundable bond paid in umber units of scarce collateral, held until its work history crosses a long verification horizon of independently attested jobs. Spawning thousands of fake identities then opens a cost canyon: every sock puppet ties up real value, and slashing burns that stake when peers catch coordinated low-effort behavior. An attacker cannot cheaply flood the market because each phantom still has to buy and risk the bond.
